summary_location.section: FAQ & Rulings / Rooms, Eggs and Items / Antidote

findings.finding: The detailed Antidote procedure omits removal of a Larva from the Character board. Its final comparison mentions Surgery’s Larva removal without saying Antidote removes one too. The English manual’s illustrated Antidote card explicitly includes Larva removal alongside removal of Infected cards. This omission can leave an Antidote user carrying a Larva despite correctly using the Item.

source_references.location: Illustrated Antidote card in Crafting column, upper center; card effect text
Scanning example identifies Surgery and Antidote as ways to remove the parasite

findings.supported_repair: In the Antidote procedure, after scanning and removing Infected cards, explicitly remove a Larva from your Character board if present. Retain the FAQ’s new Contamination, retained-hand, reshuffle and pass instructions. Phrase Surgery’s comparison so it does not imply Larva removal is exclusive to Surgery.
findings.evidence_basis: The omitted effect is legible on a card actually reproduced in the allowed original English manual; no external card corpus or inferred translation priority is required.

findings.finding: The exhausted Door supply instruction is faithful to English, which permits relocating any board Door token. PL/FR p.17 exclude destroyed Doors and DE p.17 specifies a closed Door. No supplied erratum establishes one language as controlling the others.
findings.supported_repair: No mandatory replacement of the English rule is established. Optionally label it as English-manual wording and record the narrower PL/FR/DE wording under Source limitations, without adopting a localization automatically.

localization_comparison.assessment: PL/FR p.25 explicitly place Slime before Exploration, consistent with English p.25 automatic entry and p.17 Silence conversion. Current snapshot includes this in both movement and Room reference.

All manuals p.19 give ordinary pre-roll Contamination. PL/FR p.25 explicitly condition the no-Contamination/no-Wound exception on a miss. English/German p.25 are less syntactically explicit; no supplied source establishes a blanket successful-hit exemption. Snapshot’s interpretation has a reasoned ordinary-rule/exception basis, while its unresolved miss implementation is appropriately disclosed.
All critical-moment sections p.12 specify first death. English/Polish p.26 are less restricted; French/German p.26 specify first death. Snapshot discloses the unresolved English inconsistency.
PL/FR p.22 put dropped Items under their decks, while DE p.22 removes them. English plus explicit FAQ Items 8 specifies Item discard pile; snapshot follows this stronger scoped FAQ instruction.

English/Polish p.3 list five red corpses while French/German list four; German p.6 enumerates lowest Pod numbers where English/PL/FR use random selection; French p.20 adds a strict-less-than two-card endurance paraphrase despite referring to ordinary comparison. Snapshot’s English component/setup and less-than-or-equal comparison are supported. These local differences do not establish errata.

source_supported_fidelity.assessment: MINOR: extensive faithful coverage of the original English manual plus scoped FAQ, with justified compatible localization clarifications; one actionable omission in Antidote. No MAJOR contradiction found.
source_supported_fidelity.meaning: This is a source-fidelity assessment, not a certification that all standard-core situations are resolved or every card can be played from the summary alone.

complete_core.assessment: Not established as a fully self-contained and fully resolved replacement for the original game. Repair F1, retain explicit source limitations and read card-specific effects where sources do not reproduce them.
remaining_source_gaps: All eight Adult models in Combat when another must appear.
Whether Queen development restores an already destroyed Nest when adding an Egg.
Missed Egg Melee no-Contamination implementation alongside normal pre-roll draw.
Later-death Pod re-unlocking after first unlock was reversed.
Cross-language disagreement on relocating a Door when the supply is exhausted.
complete_core.card_dependency: The original six-character Action/Item/Quest/Weakness corpus is not fully reproduced in these sources. This does not excuse overlooking an effect that is actually legible in a supplied manual illustration, as in F1.

limitations: No outside publisher clarification, web lookup, reader evidence, later edition or expansion was used.
